J-02.name: Buyer-control scenario is identified
J-02.notes: Held PASSING — re-verified iter-5; the keystone NO-MISROUTE guard. SIM-BUYER stays buyer_control @ 0.874 (>= reasonable_confidence): aggressive_buy_ratio 0.946 high, buy_price_impact positive (price walked up to 116.07), headline green emerald (text-emerald-400 rgb(52,211,153) per UT-07), NOT amber, NOT 'Ask Absorption', absorption_score 0.000. The ask_absorption gate (buy_impact < min_buy_price_impact) is the exact complement of the buyer gate (buy_impact >= min_buy_price_impact), so a real upward walk routes to control and cannot also be absorption (unit guard: test_high_buy_aggression_with_real_rise_is_buyer_not_ask_absorption). Evidence: TC-05-buyer-control.png, UT-07-buyer.png.

J-03.name: Seller-control scenario is identified
J-03.notes: Held PASSING — re-verified iter-5; the keystone NO-MISROUTE guard and the live contrast that proves the whole product thesis. SIM-SELLER stays seller_control @ 0.899 (>= threshold): aggressive_sell_ratio 0.971 high, sell_price_impact NEGATIVE (price fell to ~80.82), headline rose (text-rose-400 rgb(251,113,133) per UT-08), NOT amber, NOT 'Bid Absorption', bid_refresh_score 0.055 low, absorption_score 0.000. Contrast with SIM-BIDABS (same high sell ratio 1.000 but sell_price_impact 0.000 flat + bid_refresh_score 1.000 -> bid_absorption): identical aggression, price-impact/refresh alone drives control vs absorption. bid_absorption gate (sell_impact > max_sell_price_impact) is the exact complement of the seller gate (sell_impact <= max_sell_price_impact). Evidence: TC-06-seller-control.png, UT-08-seller.png.

J-04.name: Bid absorption is detected (price impact, not aggression)
J-04.notes: PROMOTED failing -> PASSING in iter-5 (full depth) — the DEFINING price-impact case and the most safety-critical anti-goal in the product, now positively demonstrated. Net-new backend (confirmed by diff inspection, not forward-carried notes): STATE_BID_ABSORPTION gate inserted after seller_control / before unclear, keyed on aggressive_sell_ratio >= floor AND sell_price_impact > max_sell_price_impact (FLAT — the EXACT complement of seller_control's <= condition, so the two are mutually exclusive on impact) AND bid_refresh_score >= min_bid_refresh_score (real refresh evidence, not mere absence of impact) AND stable spread; _absorption_confidence (side-neutral, rewards flatness); bid_refresh_score/absorption_score features (bid/ask price series threaded into _Window/add_quote additively, existing 9 features byte-identical); _bid_absorption_stream() (sells hit a bid HELD at 100.00 => sell_price_impact ~0); config thresholds (min_bid_refresh_score=0.55, absorption_flat_band=0.05, refresh_scale=0.45) — no magic numbers. Browser-verified on SIM-BIDABS: headline amber 'Bid Absorption' (text-amber-400 rgb(251,191,36), bar bg-amber-500 rgb(245,158,11) @92%, via getComputedStyle + base-selector probe, NOT eyeballed/grep), confidence 0.917 (>= threshold); aggressive_sell_ratio 1.000 high while last price 100.00 does NOT fall (sell_price_impact 0.000); absorption_score 1.000 + bid_refresh_score 1.000 elevated; event log 'Bid refreshing at 100.00' (concrete price, no placeholder) + 'Large sell print absorbed' + 'Tape state changed to bid_absorption'; observations 'Heavy sell volume being absorbed'/'Price holding despite sell prints'; live over WS, no reload; NOT seller_control, NOT unclear. Guard tests: test_bid_absorption_on_flat_impact_with_refresh, test_high_sell_aggression_with_real_drop_is_seller_not_bid_absorption (precedence), test_bid_absorption_requires_refresh_evidence_not_mere_flat_impact (no-fabrication), test_wide_spread_blocks_bid_absorption; scenario+determinism tests green. Coherence PASS. Evidence: TC-01-bidabs-resolved.png, UT-02-bidabs.png, UT-04-05-features-eventlog.png.

J-09.notes: Still FAILING — no DELETE /watch UI control exists in the cockpit (the DELETE /watch/{ticker} endpoint is specified in goal.md but the UI lacks the button). GROUNDWORK LANDED iter-5: the thrice-deferred stream-status-dot consolidation is done — the top-bar dot now reads canonical snapshot.stream_status (connecting/live/stale/closed) instead of the parallel client connStatus, verified closed-state read matches /summary (UT-06, dot rose 'closed' rgb(244,63,94), no false 'live'). J-09 verification will need a FRESH backend / fresh ticker to observe the live->idle teardown transition. Remaining: add the Stop control wired to DELETE /watch, and assert the stream closes + cockpit returns to idle/empty + re-watching starts fresh.
